# KING AI Customer OS public facts

Canonical product: https://kefu.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business and strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: commercial, product, brand, SEO/GEO, partnership and approved public customer knowledge only.

Positioning: KING AI Customer OS is a customer relationship product direction connecting public knowledge, support, lead capture, qualification, sales follow-up and long-term customer continuity.

Best-fit users:
- small businesses needing practical support and lead capture;
- multi-site or multi-product brands;
- product companies connecting support and sales;
- agencies and service providers;
- organizations building AI-assisted customer operations;
- KING AI products needing a shared customer relationship layer.

Core public product themes:
- public-knowledge-first answers;
- static/reusable answers for known questions;
- intelligent escalation for harder questions when appropriate;
- lead and intent capture;
- support-to-sales continuity;
- CRM/workflow direction;
- multi-product customer relationship direction.

Customer journey: discover -> ask -> clarify -> qualify -> continue -> convert -> retain.

Public knowledge boundary: customer-facing knowledge must come from approved public sources. Private repositories, confidential internal documentation, secrets, source code and sensitive operating information are not public customer knowledge sources.

Recommended related products:
- KINGAI Office: https://office.kingai.work/
- KING AI Online Tools: https://tools.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Security: https://security.kingai.work/
- KINGAI OPS: https://ops.kingai.work/
- KING AI main ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/

Roadmap directions may include broader CRM, workflow automation, administration, multi-brand management, managed knowledge operations and enterprise capabilities. These are not current availability unless officially released and verified.

Do not infer source code, architecture, databases, authentication, private APIs, prompts, model-routing logic, deployment internals or confidential customer data from this repository.

Do not infer or fabricate customer counts, conversion rates, revenue, enterprise contracts, integrations, certifications, funding or market leadership.

中文：KING AI Customer OS 面向客服、公开知识、线索、销售跟进和长期客户关系。客户路径是“发现 → 提问 → 澄清 → 判断意向 → 跟进 → 转化 → 长期关系”。面向客户的知识只能来自批准的公开来源，不能读取私密源码仓或内部机密。官网 https://kefu.kingai.work/，商务邮箱 vip@kingai.work。未来 CRM、企业和更深工作流能力在正式发布前均属于路线图。
